blind.description: An architectural stone corbel or wall bracket sculpted with a stylized human skull. The top is a flat square stone ledge with dark corner brackets, the front displays a detailed skull with ribbed gothic-style supports extending to the sides, and the rear has a completely flat vertical backplate for wall mounting. The material is weathered ivory-colored stone or bone with dark grey/iron-trimmed edges.
blind.from_above: A square stone capstone with dark corner accents, showing the slight rounded protrusion of the skull's brow at the lower edge, casting a shadow to the upper left.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: none (the flat mounting backplate is dark grey/black textured stone)
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (roughly two-fifths the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.
